name: Sovjonok: Poslednij koshmar
source: The "Sovjonok" reminds of itself every day. Headaches, nightmares at night, illnesses — all this does not let Alexander go, he needs to do something, but what? How to defeat demons, how to overcome the evil that hung over him? Fate is kind to our hero and he meets one person who can help. But not everything is so simple, you have to pay for a normal life, but it seems that Sasha has no choice. Will he succeed? Will life be the same? Would he die or become a pawn of the demons? That's what you're going to find out.
translation: “Sovjonok”每天都会提醒自己。头痛、夜间噩梦、疾病——这一切都没有让亚历山大离开，他需要做点什么，但是做什么呢？如何战胜心魔，如何战胜笼罩在他身上的邪恶？命运对我们的英雄很仁慈，他遇到了一个可以帮助他的人。但事情并非如此简单，正常的生活就要付出代价，但萨沙似乎别无选择。他会成功吗？生活还会一样吗？他会死还是成为恶魔的棋子？这就是你将会发现的。
